notes: Information review: eighteen recorded sessions across iRacing, Assetto Corsa and ACC swept end to end. SMART now answers only from the data it was given, with the delta's direction spelled out, your three costliest corners in hand and no invented figures. What counts as a lap was rebuilt: an ACC event that would not open, another counting every lap twice, a session of garage time reading as clean laps, a session where every lap had a track-limits incident reporting no clean lap at all, a lap cut short offered as a personal best, and a reference slower than your own best lap making Turn 1 worth 8.6 seconds. Corner numbering is the circuit's everywhere, including on ACC. Plus all of 0.9.146 and 0.9.147.
